title: Cart latency from valkey memory pressure and key evictions

body.symptom: Checkout and add-to-cart latency rose; cart p95 above 800 ms
body.confirmed_cause: valkey-cart reached its memory limit and evicted keys; cart fell back to slow reconstruction
body.lessons: Check valkey hit ratio, evictions and cart client span latency to valkey before blaming cart itself.

title: Checkout failures after a payment feature flag was enabled

body.symptom: Checkout error ratio increased to roughly a third of orders
body.confirmed_cause: A payment feature flag rollout made a share of charge requests fail
body.lessons: Error traces terminated in payment Charge; flag change time matched error onset within a minute.

title: Email service OOM restarts slowed order confirmation

body.symptom: Intermittent checkout latency spikes; email container restarting
body.confirmed_cause: Memory growth in email until the container limit, then OOM kill and restart
body.lessons: Container events showed oom/die events; memory climbed steadily between restarts.

title: Currency CPU quota lowered during cost optimisation

body.symptom: Frontend and checkout latency increased; no errors
body.confirmed_cause: Container CPU limit for currency reduced; requests queued behind CFS throttling
body.lessons: Throttled-period ratio jumped while CPU utilisation sat at the new limit; restoring the limit recovered p95 within two minutes.

body.symptom: Product pages and checkout slow; product-catalog server latency high with low CPU
body.confirmed_cause: Long-held locks in the catalog database serialised queries
body.lessons: Low CPU with high latency pointed away from saturation; trace self time sat in product-catalog database spans.
